concepts.name: White PVC Manifold
concepts.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Original Drain Damage game controller concept made from real plumbing materials, not based on any commercial controller. ONE isolated controller, front/top view almost orthographic, both grip ends visible, centered large with generous margins. Landscape 3:2 image, opaque plain light cool-gray studio background, soft shadow. Polished realistic product concept rendering, humorous DIY plumbing craftsmanship, clean legible controls, no slime. CONTROL LAYOUT must be consistent and unmistakable: black raised cross D-pad upper-left, four large circular colored face buttons upper-right in a diamond labeled exactly Y at top (yellow), X at left (blue), B at right (red), A at bottom (green); two dark rubber analog sticks level with each other on lower central deck, each with distinct washer collar; two small rectangular center buttons with simple pause and menu pictograms; visible pair of shoulder tabs on top edge. Spacious control deck, bold button shapes visible when reduced to 315x210 pixels, minimal tiny detail, do not obscure controls with tubing. No logos, no brand names, no controller cables, no hands, no extra objects or text, no recognizable Xbox/PlayStation/Nintendo silhouette, no cheese. Body built from white PVC elbows and a short rectangular central junction box, curved elbow grips wrapped with dark rubber. Orange couplers and blue washer accents.
